allowed_access: one complete GET of README file 1619636 only
schema_questions: Does documentation define a site identifier?
Does documentation define a repeatable quadrat identifier nested within site?
Does documentation define year or survey date?
Does documentation define Zostera percent cover and a valid observed zero distinct from missing?
pass_rule: All four schema questions must be unambiguous from README and already-public paper methods before any biological CSV access.
failure_rule: Ambiguous stable-unit identity or zero semantics terminates v1 before biological CSV access.
